messages:
evan: Quick idea following the RFC: build a lightweight regional "edge quota gateway" focused on prefix caching + probe batching. aim is to drop short-lived chatter hitting the central bank and keep the bank focused on durable reservations.

anjali: can you sketch the probe lifecycle? curious about cache semantics and probe aggregation.

evan: sketch: edge proxy -> gateway. gateway keeps a small LRU for recent "prefix keys" (tenant+route+short-hash). on miss it coalesces probes for N ms (10-50ms) then calls bank. bank reply = {allow/deny, lease_id?, ttl, fairness_score}. gateway returns a soft-allow immediately when cached.

mike: how do you define prefix vs full token? implies gateway acts on short-lived heuristics only. we need firm boundaries so we don't duplicate fairness logic.

evan: exactly. gateway only handles short TTL soft-allow (<= 5s) and coalescing. long-lived leases still go direct to bank or use bank-issued lease ids. gateway must never decide durable fairness.

sara: failure modes? if bank latency spikes, gateway coalescing could add head-of-line delay. do we expose a circuit-breaker?

evan: yes: gateway has three modes: normal, probe-backoff (increase coalescing window to reduce bank QPS), and degraded (serve cache only up to graceTTL then 429). transitions are metric-driven (bank latency >= p95 threshold, error rate spike).

lucas: what about abuse signals? we must not let a bad client bypass central detection by surfing cached soft-allow.

evan: gateway subscribes to short-window abuse deltas (push from abuse pipeline). if a tenant gets flagged high-risk, gateway invalidates cached prefixes for that tenant and rejects with a soft-deny and emits an event to the bank.

anjali: ops: how many entries in LRU? memory? eviction visibility?

evan: small footprint: 50k entries per gateway node (~100MB). eviction emits a metric. also include per-tenant hit/miss counters.

mike: we need a clear audit trail: every gateway decision must include trace id and a signed header from gateway so bank can retroactively validate decision chain.

evan: agree. include X-Quota-Gateway-Trace and a gateway-sig (HMAC with region key) on responses. bank will verify for any disputed admits.

sara: security: keys per region, rotated via KMS. what's the auth between gateway and bank? mTLS + service identity?

evan: mTLS with short-lived certs + per-node identity from vault. keys rotated weekly by default.

lucas: rollout plan? prefer incremental canary by region or by tenant?

evan: start with internal tenants and low-traffic regions. step 1: passive mode (gateway proxies but always forward to bank, collect metrics). step 2: soft-allow enabled for internal tenants. step 3: expand to PLG customers. revert plan: edge proxy can bypass gateway quickly via feature flag.

security-bot: reminder: add privacy review for event payloads (INFRA-PRIV-45).

anjali: SLOs: what do we promise? gateway should add <2ms p50 overhead on happy path and reduce bank QPS by at least 20% for bursty flows to justify cost.

evan: target those numbers. lucas, can you run a micro-sim with current burst patterns and a 3-node gateway cluster per region?

lucas: will do. initial sims show ~30% QPS reduction with 5s soft TTL and 20ms coalescing window for very spiky clients.

mike: engineering tasks: proto + API (lucas), gateway binary + LRU impl (sara), observability + audit events (anjali), security vetting (security team). I'll file an INFRA ticket and assign.

evan: one more thought on policy: gateway exposes a tiny policy hook for ops to tune graceTTL and coalescing window per-tenant class. but heavy policy stays in bank.

sara: add a debug endpoint to replay decision history for a request id. helps triage misadmits.

evan: agreed. we'll also log sampled raw payloads to secure, short-lived storage for 24h for incident debug.

mike: if there are no objections, we'll spin a PoC branch and run it in staging this sprint. thanks all. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: created INFRA-1245 "edge-quota-gateway PoC: prefix cache + probe batching" assigned to lucas, sara, anjali due 2w.
